sources.title: Introducing Muse Spark: Scaling Towards Personal Superintelligence
sources.snippet: Muse Spark is the first step on our scaling ladder and the first product of a ground-up overhaul of our AI efforts. To support further scaling, we are making strategic investments across the entire stack — from research and model training to infrastructure, including the Hyperion data center.
